notes.title: GunGirl 2 coming to Steam for FREE!
notes.notes:
Since its first release, many fans have asked me to publish GunGirl 2 on Steam. Now, all the stars have aligned and it is finally possible to release GunGirl 2 on Steam -- for FREE!

GunGirl 2 was my first "major" game that I have developed all by myself in a timespan of about 2 years. It's a labor of love and seeing it here on Steam makes me very proud. I really hope you like the game and even if you have played it already, maybe you want to check it out again :)

For more info about the game, check out www.gungirl2.com

Have a great day! ːherofionaː
